facts.fact: DecryptEco reports Raxio opened a commercial Tier III data centre in Kinshasa in May 2024 (USD 30m, up to 400 racks, 1.5 MW) for banks, telecom operators, cloud providers and enterprises, still a main hosting facility in the country.
DecryptEco describes Raxio's Kinshasa data centre, opened May 2024, as the DRC's first commercial Tier III data centre (certifier not named in this article).

DecryptEco reports Open Access Data Centres (OADC) opened its first Kinshasa data centre, at Silikin Village, some months before Raxio's May 2024 opening, as a local interconnection point and content hub.

systems.system: Lofoy data centre (Universite Nouveaux Horizons, Lubumbashi)

note: Lofoy itself (inaugurated 2026-06-27) is aimed at research and institutions, not stated to rent to others, so no fact for it.
